channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: France experiences a record 36 consecutive days of rain
item.description: If you feel like the rain has been endless in France recently, you're nearly right - the country has broken a record with 36 consecutive days of rain since the start of the year.

item.title: French hard-left party says evacuates Paris HQ after 'bomb threat'
item.description: France's hard-left party said it had had to evacuate its national headquarters over a "bomb threat" Wednesday, after prosecutors confirmed 11 arrests over the fatal beating of a far-right activist last week blamed on the ultra left.

item.title: French phrase of the day: À table
item.description: This phrase is heard in every French household.

item.title: French films with English subtitles to see in March
item.description: Cinematic March madness, with numerous screenings throughout the month, including two from influential New Wave director Agnes Varga, the 21st-century return of a classic French detective, and a heart-breaking tale of life, ageing and death.

item.title: OPINION: Macron's offer to 'extend' the French nuclear umbrella to Europe is fraught with problems
item.description: Sharing umbrellas is never easy. France has offered to 'extend' its nuclear umbrella to other European countries without actually 'sharing' it. How can that work, asks John Lichfield.

item.title: Man missing in floods as France braces for more rain
item.description: A man has gone missing in the Loire River in the flood-hit west of France, an official said, as the country on Wednesday broke its record for the longest period of rain, with more to come.

item.title: How UK-France dual nationals can renounce British citizenship
item.description: If you wish to give up British citizenship - here's how to do it, how much it costs and how, in some cases, you can get it back.

item.title: French rail union files strike notice for February holiday getaway weekend
item.description: The union representing train conductors working in the Paris region has filed a strike notice for the weekend - expected to be a busy travel time as Paris schools break up for the February holiday.

item.title: PODCAST: France fears more political violence and record rainfall leaves the country under water
item.description: The Talking France podcast is back looking at the storms - both meteorological and political - that have gripped France this week, plus the country's biggest farm show and those pesky French 'false friends'.

item.title: Hacker accesses info on 1.2 mn French bank accounts
item.description: The French economy ministry said Wednesday that a hacker gained access to a national bank account database and consulted information on 1.2 million accounts.
